content: Gender, race, religion, nationality are all characteristics that we deem unfair to classify on, and these ethical standpoints needs to be taken into account in systems' design. Characteristics that are not considered as relevant in a given task can be encapsulated in data nonetheless, and lead to bias performance. Being aware of the demographic skews our data set might contain is a first step to track the life cycle of a training data set and a necessary step to control the tools we develop.
